author: Crystal Posey
text: We had to have new field lines put in. Pickle Plumbing and Septic Tank completed it within the week of diagnosing the issue. Everyone we met was kind, friendly, and easy to talk to. Great experience, highly recommend!

author: Deborah Gaston
text: Pickle recently handled a septic tank inspection for Mary Lou's Team at a home in Alabaster. They are always prompt, reliable and accurate. They provide reporting the next day. We appreciate their service. They are especially helpful when we need them to work with us when closing a real estate property. Thank you for your great service. Mary Lou's Team ReMax Advantage.

author: Patricia Attaway
text:
An inspector came and inspected our home, because we are selling it.  One of his evaluations was we had water in the line to the septic tank.   I called this company  because they have done great work each time I called to have my septic tank emptied.
From the moment Nolan called to say they were 10 minutes away, till the minor issue was handled; they were very courteous and friendly.   Nolan was polite and respectful in his interactions.
Thank you Nolan and Tristin!

author: Amy Whalen
text: Pickle came to our rescue within a couple of hours of being called and quickly figured out my problem AND pumped out my septic tank. All for an incredibly reasonable price! Courteous and helpful. Great company!

author: Susan Pattison
text: Finally not only a great company but an honest one. I highly recommend Pickle Plumbing and Septic. Brenda in the office is so kind and very helpful.
